xmldoc.short_description: Return the nflow block library search paths.

param_output_item.param_description: the current nflow library search paths, a cell array of character vectors.

description.p: NFlow.librarypaths returns the directories currently scanned for external nflow block libraries. The list is the one shared by sim, code generation and the editor, and is changed with NFlow.addlibrarypath and NFlow.rmlibrarypath.

example_item.example_item_description: List the registered library search paths.
